connections.why: Partial fractions reduce integrands to standard forms
Deriving the derivative from the limit is itself a formal proof
Exponential growth/decay arises from dy/dx = ky
Standard rules generalise the first-principles definition
Integration is the inverse process, with parts mirroring product rule
Stationary points require setting derivatives to zero
Solving separable ODEs requires integrating both sides
Identities transform equations into solvable forms
Calculus of trig functions requires radian measure
Dot product is defined on component-form vectors
Work and motion in mechanics use vector components
Both rely on summation notation and pattern recognition
The binomial distribution uses binomial coefficients
Tests use distributions to find critical regions and p-values
PMCC significance is itself a hypothesis test
Newton's second law links forces to acceleration in SUVAT
Rigid-body equilibrium needs both force and moment balance
